scope: Expose source-bound cloning-field presence for plain DWG DICTIONARY records inside the dwg2dxf adapter, without changing output admission or the public libdxfrw class layout.
implementation: The observation returns Absent with no source value for AC1012/AC1014 plain dictionaries, and Present with the captured scalar for AC1015–AC1032. It is available only for a successful current DWG import with a unique live dictionary, matching raw frame, publication, complete membership, source profile and reparsed typed baseline. DICTIONARYWDFLT is excluded.

The immutable source result reports whether the current scalar equals the import baseline. A same-value direct assignment cannot be distinguished from no assignment; the result does not establish user intent, dictionary graph closure, an output default or native clone semantics. Unknown and stale queries clear their result.
No public DRW_Interface virtual, installed libdxfrw data-class member or object layout changed; existing DXF/DWG serialization and support-claim policy are untouched.
